name: regression
description: Performance Factory regression workflow: detector alert to verified recovery.

taskStore.primary: Tuturuuu Tasks Fleet board via the ttr CLI
taskStore.recordFormat: JSON task record in a fenced json block at the end of the task description

stages.subscription: two full detector windows after the production deploy

dataGate.comparableWindow: newest complete filtered window of the candidate's app (detector candidates[].window, zero-padded if empty)
dataGate.list: keep current ready list (Queued or Live Today)
dataGate.meaning: Not a failure and not a regression: too little traffic to judge the p95 or error rate.
dataGate.record: dataGate: { state, observedRequests, minRequests, window }; keep the task in its current ready list (Queued or Live Today) with its stage unchanged
dataGate.dispatcher: run perf-dispatch-gate.mjs (extract-candidates, intake-check, gate) with board-list-annotated tasks and dispatch only its dispatchable task keys; fails closed on missing/non-ready list, zone-less readyAfter/deployedAt, stored verification blocker (clears only when verdict is recovered/passed/cleared/reopened with an explicit zoned verification.clearedAt or updatedAt), unmet verify-post-deploy precondition, dataGate, insufficient_data, unchecked, extraction/detector failure, or missing candidates; intake-check skips on exact regression id only; log only on entry and re-arm
dataGate.rearm: detector candidates[].state returns ready (transition true) once the newest window has minRequestsPerWindow requests; clear dataGate and resume at the recorded stage unless a stored verification blocker remains
